summary.name: Site Reliability Engineering Munich
summary.one_liner: A Meetup group in Munich, Germany for site reliability engineers and system engineers to share on-call experiences and learn about reliability.
use_cases: Finding SRE community events in Munich
Learning about the second edition of the Google SRE book
Hearing how teams build in-cluster SRE agents
Networking with site reliability engineers in Munich
summary.what_it_does:
This is a Meetup group page for Site Reliability Engineering Munich, organized to bring together SREs, on-call engineers and system and software engineers. The page describes a specific upcoming meetup hosted at Google, with an agenda of food and drinks, two talks, a discussion and networking. One talk covers what changed in the second edition of the Google SRE book, written by a Google SRE who co-edited it. The other covers EGYM's in-cluster SRE agent built on HolmesGPT, which answers alert questions in Slack and is limited to read-only actions. Organizers can be reached at muc@sre.xyz. The page also lists it under Conferences and Meetups in the awesome-sre list.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Hosted at Google's Munich office with talks on the second edition of the SRE book
Talk on an in-cluster SRE agent built on HolmesGPT that is read-only and answers in Slack alert threads
Guests must register with real names and bring a valid ID for building entry
caveats: Google requires real-name registration and photo ID to enter the building
Attendance is limited to registered guests; attendees must cancel if they cannot come
